subject.title: [Performance]: Profile buildSessionEntry memory pressure during large-agent full reindex

question: Should this issue stay as a standalone profiling task until a large-agent RSS/heap run is captured, or should it be folded into the broader session-memory performance tracker now?
rationale: Source inspection confirms the suspected hotspot, but the requested next step is measurement and the right closure boundary depends on maintainer proof expectations rather than a mechanical code fix.

options.title: Keep standalone profiling task
options.body: Keep this issue open until a maintainer or tester captures peak RSS/heap evidence from a large-agent full reindex, then decide whether a code fix is needed.

options.title: Fold into performance tracker
options.body: Treat the profiling ask as supporting evidence for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/40919 and continue all implementation discussion there.

options.title: Close after safe measurement
options.body: If profiling shows safe peak memory on current main, close this as a confirmed non-issue while leaving broader incremental-indexing work separate.

recommendation.title: Keep standalone profiling task
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until a maintainer or tester captures peak RSS/heap evidence from a large-agent full reindex, then decide whether a code fix is needed.
